remarks: Conveniently situated in the heart of downtown Greenwich, you'll fall in love with this sunny two-bedroom condo! Moments to Greenwich Avenue's renowned shopping and dining, as well as the Greenwich train station, it is hard to beat the ease of this location. The unit features charming arched doorways, a renovated kitchen, updated full bathroom, fireplace, and two spacious bedrooms, along with abundant natural light and charm. Don't miss this downtown gem!
